svg.title: Layers of public historical record provenance
svg.desc: Four distinct evidence objects: a document produced at the time, a later finding aid describing archival custody, an institutional history presenting the organization's account, and a historian's interpretation. Arrows show citation and comparison, not automatic verification.
svg.text: Four evidence objects, four different questions
Trace author, date, custodian, description, release context, and the claim each object can support.

text.tspan: Who created it, when, for whom,
and what does the item actually say?
Who holds or describes a record group?
What scope and gaps does the archive state?
How does the organization narrate its
How do historians support and qualify

svg.text: A public index is not the complete archive; institutional histories do not prove present capability.
